name: live-announcer
title: LiveAnnouncer
description: Screen-reader announcements for changes with no visible text: a polite (role="status") and an assertive aria-live region, plus `useAnnounce()` for any component below it. Used by KanbanBoard for pick-up / move / drop / cancel. Outside a LiveAnnouncer, `useAnnounce()` is a no-op.
author: gntik-ai
